gloss: waitlist; waiting for a cancellation; standby

definitions.gloss: waitlist; standby; waiting for a cancellation
definitions.explanation: Putting your name down for a fully booked flight, restaurant, class, or hotel in the hope that someone else cancels. Also refers to the waiting list itself.

examples.japanese: キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I booked it on the waitlist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おいた。
examples.english: It was fully booked, so I put my name on the waitlist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: It's a popular inn, so I waited for a cancellation and got a room the day before departure.

notes:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to wait for a cancellation). Common in travel, restaurant booking, concert tickets, and popular lessons or childcare places.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wait for a cancellation
- キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to get on the waitlist
- キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a cancellation slot opens up
- キャンセル{待|ま}ち⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: the waiting list

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順番待|じゅんばんま}ち→順番待ち：09747_junbanmachi⟧: waiting one's turn — waiting in an ordinary queue, not for a cancellation
- ⟦{空|あ}き→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: waiting for an opening — broader, includes waiting for capacity to be added
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: reservation — the confirmed booking that a waitlist is not yet
